policy: Only reviewed text producers with exact widget FontObjects are checked. Source changes invalidate the whole mapping, including aliases, callbacks and font overrides. Review source and callers before updating sha256. Unlisted dynamic text, template-owned fonts and consumer helper arguments have no coverage claim. Empty bindings record reviewed exclusions, not glyph coverage.

producers.review: Read all of Tracker.lua, Tracker.xml and ForeverCore TrackerSection.Create, UpdateText and TrackerLine.SetInteractive. Confirmed pinned client Blizzard_ObjectiveTrackerModule.xml: ObjectiveTrackerModuleTemplate Header inherits ObjectiveTrackerModuleHeaderTemplate, whose Text uses ObjectiveTrackerHeaderFont. Blizzard_ObjectiveTrackerBlock.xml HeaderText uses ObjectiveTrackerLineFont; Blizzard_ObjectiveTrackerShared.xml ObjectiveTrackerLineTemplate Text uses ObjectiveTrackerLineFont, inherited without overrides by ShortestPathForeverTrackerLineTemplate. Bound every local phrase sent to section headers, block headers and rows, including Journey  %s · %s from #838. RefreshBlockText preserves these widgets. Client tracker text-size changes and optional Kaliels font overrides are outside the pinned native-font coverage. Menus, chat, tooltips and dynamic text from JourneyInfo, DockTitle, and DepartureText are excluded. Reviewed #1005: the transport row menus use ForeverCore.ContextMenu. Its tooltips and labels establish no tracker FontObject. Re-reviewed for #1240: the only edit is a TrackerMenu RestedXP presence guard; no producer text, SetHeader, SetText or SetFont call changed. Reviewed #1261: the unavailable-tracker message uses the client's on-screen notice area. It never writes to a tracker widget.

Reviewed the avoided transport failure row from AvoidTransport.Row, which JourneyInfo returns as its first row. UI/Tracker.lua passes the row text to AddObjective using ShortestPathForeverTrackerLineTemplate, which inherits ObjectiveTrackerLineFont. Pin consumers use template-owned tooltip fonts. Rechecked tracker rendering after the search retry change. JourneyInfo selects the existing error text for a thrown search. The avoid row uses the same font and phrase when the planner finds no route after filtering.

producers.review: Read Tracker.xml and its Tracker.lua LINE_TEMPLATE, LayoutContents and RefreshBlockText callers. ShortestPathForeverTrackerLineTemplate inherits ObjectiveTrackerLineTemplate without a font override; pinned Blizzard_ObjectiveTrackerShared.xml gives both Text and Dash ObjectiveTrackerLineFont. TrackerSection.Create passes this line template to the module; TrackerLine.SetInteractive changes mouse scripts only. XML declares no locale phrase or addon runtime text, so bindings live with the phrases in Tracker.lua. Dynamic row text and client QUEST_DASH are excluded.

Read Page, Checkbox, Scale, Dropdown and Saving and their registration calls. Settings rows, index buttons and option labels delegate to Blizzard secure initializers; this file creates no FontString and establishes no explicit FontObject. Minimap button text, tooltip text, chat output and helper arguments are excluded rather than assigned an assumed settings font. Reviewed #1094: the Tracker heading's Attach to quest tracker row is ForeverCore.SettingsSections.RegisterTrackerAttach, a core-owned initializer, registered only when the running core has it (an older adopted standalone does not); excluded with the other settings fonts. Reviewed #1142: the journeyHint row is one more Checkbox helper call, a Blizzard secure initializer with no FontString or FontObject of its own. Reviewed #1033: the Off-path tolerance row and Arrival distance share a DistanceSlider helper that registers a Blizzard secure slider initializer, with no FontString or FontObject of its own. Reviewed #1005: the Avoided transport row is one more native button initializer with plain string text and tooltip; the client owns its fonts. Reviewed #1241: the new "Show the journey key hint on the minimap" row is one more Checkbox helper call, like journeyHint in #1142, so it adds a Blizzard secure initializer's row and no FontString or FontObject of its own; the digest moved for the row and its shortened journeyHint description, not for a font producer. Reviewed the RestedXP tooltip updates. Blizzard settings initializers own their fonts. Reviewed #1261: the update notice description still goes through the Blizzard Checkbox initializer, which owns its font.

Read Register and every rows builder call. All phrases are helper arguments to Settings.lua builders and Blizzard settings initializers, with no explicit FontObject in this producer. Tooltip descriptions and dynamic choice labels have no coverage claim. Reviewed the new checkbox. Blizzard settings initializers own its fonts.

Read dock, service and portal pin creation and tooltip callbacks. Map.xml defines textures without label FontStrings; localized destination, landing and direction phrases flow into tooltips or helper results, as does the journey click hint (ns.AddJourneyClickHint). Tooltip fonts belong to their templates, menu fonts are not established here, and dynamic location names are excluded. Reviewed the new map filter label and visibility callback. The menu owns its fonts.

Read Number creation and SetStop/tooltip paths. Number explicitly uses GameFontNormal but displays a dynamic stop number, not a locale phrase. The time-distance phrase, stop descriptions and clear hints are tooltip text owned by the tooltip template; none is bound to Number.

Read Create, ArrowLabel, distance updates, arrival labels, progress and cast prompt. MoverHint uses GameFontHighlightSmall and Distance uses GameFontNormal, including the formatted time-distance phrase. No later font override occurs. Dynamic objective lines, arrival titles, route titles and actions from helpers are excluded; this review does not claim coverage for their inserted text. Reviewed #1161: NativeMarkerAt and the shared-marker stand-down read C_Navigation and C_Map only; no FontString, FontObject or text change. Reviewed #1035: the cast prompt's secure button moved to UI/CastButton.lua and writes only GameTooltip text; no FontString, FontObject or text change here. Reviewed RestedXP arrow ownership: direction visibility changes without changing text, font objects or bindings. Reviewed #1251: the corpse-run exception in DirectionsShown is removed; visibility only, no FontString, FontObject or text change. Reviewed #1254: ArrowShown is split out of DirectionsShown, and the hidden-for-RestedXP path now places the native marker without drawing the frame; visibility and marker placement only, no FontString, FontObject or text change.

producers.review: Read BuildHeader, BuildContent, CreateBetterRow, PaintBetter, Where and Refresh. headerTitle uses GameFontNormalLarge2; emptyText uses GameFontDisable for STATUS and empty/position notices; better-row Label uses GameFontHighlight for the name-zone format and subtitle uses GameFontHighlight for Where.
